bugs.summary: The bash-v2 completion script reads candidate lines with `while IFS='' read -r compline; ... done < <(printf "%s\n" "$out")`, and the last read yields an empty line after the trailing newline. The old filter `comp=$(compgen -W "$comp" -- "$cur"); [[ -z $comp ]] && continue` dropped that empty entry. The new prefix test `[[ $comp == "$cur"* ]]` matches the empty string whenever nothing has been typed yet ($cur is empty), so an empty completion is added to COMPREPLY when completions have descriptions.
bugs.trigger: Press TAB with nothing typed on a command whose completions carry descriptions: an extra empty candidate appears. The fix (e1ded5cd, #1691, 'Regression from fb8031162c') adds `[[ -z $compline ]] && continue` before the filter.
